summary: Beschman (Putney) lookout atop Pine Mountain, Harlan County, KY; build date conflicts (1929 vs late 1930s); decommissioned by the 1970s and deteriorating; NHLR 2026.

facts.height_note: 100-foot (about 30.5 m) steel tower planned per the May 1929 newspaper; built height not verified
facts.status_note: April 2025 article calls the steel rusted and deteriorating but still standing; no later report found
facts.agency: Kentucky Division of Forestry (per 2025 article); state property inside Kentenia State Forest

staffing.status: staffed daily during the dry seasons; firefighting base through the 1940s and 1950s

access.note: Decommissioned by the 1970s; lower stair flights removed to discourage trespassing; no official open status found. Do not climb.

visit.trail_note: Approach road is Gross Knob Tower Road, built by the CCC per the 2025 article; no official visitor information found

events.note: Marker stone reads 1929 per the 2025 article; a May 1929 newspaper describes engineering of a 100-foot steel tower. The article also ties CCC and Division of Forestry work to the late 1930s.
Restoration of the Putney Ranger Station, a separate building, was under way but short of funding

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources disagree: 1929 (marker stone and a 1929 newspaper on engineering the tower) versus late-1930s CCC and Division of Forestry work. The story states both; the record keeps 1929 as the earliest documented date.
NHLR gives 2,662 ft (811 m); the 2025 article gives roughly 2,726 ft atop Pine Mountain. The record keeps the NHLR figure.

notes_for_editor: Build date unresolved (1929 vs late 1930s); height_m is null; the 1929 planned 100 ft (30.5 m) is recorded in height_note, not as a measured height. Current condition rests on one 2025 article; no agency status found. Closed status is inferred from decommissioning and removed stairs. The 2019 Harlan Enterprise piece is about the ranger station, not the tower. Name variants searched: Beschman, Putney, Putney Fire Tower. A search snippet mentioned a Pine Mountain Settlement School inventory listing a Gross Knob Fire Tower; not verified, not used.
